title: Plentiful Potions
description: Adding custom poitions recipes and giving abilities to unused vanilla effects and craftable potions!
body:
Seven new brewable potions for **Minecraft Java 26.3+** - including Haste, Levitation, Resistance, Conduit Power, and the Bedrock-exclusive Potion of Decay, now available in survival Java. Drop the datapack into your world's `datapacks` folder and run `/reload`. No mods required. --- ## Highlights - **Haste** - mine and fight faster, brewed from copper and echo shards - **Levitation** - float upward, brewed from wind charges - **Glowing** - outline players and mobs, brewed from glow berries and glow ink sacs - **Resistance** - reduce incoming damage, brewed from a shield and quartz - **Conduit Power** - breathe and mine underwater, brewed through a three-step chain from Haste - **Luck** - **doubles all XP earned** while the effect is active - **Decay** - inflict **Wither II**, brewed from wither roses (Bedrock's Potion of Decay) Most potions support vanilla modifiers: **Redstone** (extended), **Glowstone** (strong), **Gunpowder** (splash), and **Dragon's Breath** (lingering). Luck and Decay include splash and lingering variants. --- ## Potions at a glance | Potion | Effect | How to brew | Extended | Strong | Splash | Lingering | |--------|--------|-------------|:--------:|:------:|:------:|:---------:| | Haste | Haste I / II | Awkward → Copper Nugget → Echo Shard | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | | Levitation | Levitation I | Awkward + Wind Charge | ✓ | - | ✓ | ✓ | | Glowing | Glowing | Awkward → Glow Berries → Glow Ink Sac | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | | Resistance | Resistance I / II | Awkward → Shield → Quartz | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | | Conduit Power | Conduit Power | Haste → Golden Carrot → Pufferfish → Prismarine Shard | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | | Luck | Luck (+ double XP) | Awkward + Rabbit's Foot | - | - | ✓ | ✓ | | Decay | Wither II | Awkward + Wither Rose | - | - | ✓ | ✓ | **Typical durations:** regular 3:00 · extended 8:00 · strong 1:30 (one tier higher) · levitation extended 4:00 · decay splash 0:40 · decay lingering cloud 0:10 --- ## Installation 1. Download and extract the datapack. 2. Copy the `PlentifulPotions-[ver]-[mcver].zip` into `/datapacks/`. 3. Run `/reload`, or rejoin the world. 4. run /datapack enable `PlentifulPotions-[ver]-[mcver].zip` ---
Full brewing recipes ### Modifiers | Ingredient | Result | |------------|--------| | Redstone Dust | Extended duration | | Glowstone Dust | Stronger effect (where available) | | Gunpowder | Splash potion | | Dragon's Breath | Lingering potion (from splash) | --- ### Haste | Input | + Reagent | → Output | |-------|-----------|----------| | Awkward Potion | Copper Nugget | Copper Age Infusion | | Copper Age Infusion | Echo Shard | Potion of Haste | Apply Redstone, Glowstone, Gunpowder, and Dragon's Breath using the standard modifier chain. --- ### Levitation | Input | + Reagent | → Output | |-------|-----------|----------| | Awkward Potion | Wind Charge | Potion of Levitation | No strong variant. Supports extended, splash, and lingering modifiers. --- ### Glowing | Input | + Reagent | → Output | |-------|-----------|----------| | Awkward Potion | Glow Berries | Glowing Infusion | | Glowing Infusion | Glow Ink Sac | Potion of Glowing | Full modifier support. --- ### Resistance | Input | + Reagent | → Output | |-------|-----------|----------| | Awkward Potion | Shield | Resistance Infusion | | Resistance Infusion | Quartz | Potion of Resistance | The shield is consumed during brewing. Full modifier support. --- ### Conduit Power Requires a regular **Potion of Haste** (3:00, not extended or strong). | Input | + Reagent | → Output | |-------|-----------|----------| | Potion of Haste | Golden Carrot | Golden Hasty Brew | | Golden Hasty Brew | Pufferfish | Golden Hasty Puffer Brew | | Golden Hasty Puffer Brew | Prismarine Shard | Potion of Conduit Power | Full modifier support. --- ### Luck | Input | + Reagent | → Output | |-------|-----------|----------| | Awkward Potion | Rabbit's Foot | Potion of Luck | | Potion of Luck | Gunpowder | Splash Potion of Luck | | Splash Potion of Luck | Dragon's Breath | Lingering Potion of Luck | While the Luck effect is active, **all XP gained is doubled** - from mining, combat, smelting, breeding, and other sources. This is custom datapack behaviour beyond vanilla Luck. --- ### Decay | Input | + Reagent | → Output | |-------|-----------|----------| | Awkward Potion | Wither Rose | Potion of Decay | | Potion of Decay | Gunpowder | Splash Potion of Decay | | Splash Potion of Decay | Dragon's Breath | Lingering Potion of Decay | Wither II (0:40) when drunk or splashed. The lingering cloud applies Wither II (0:10), matching Bedrock Edition. All variants use the same dark wither colour.
